content: Jesus diniciaceeketetege libatadi “uuva”
Odaa jeɡ̶ee Jesus, “Ee idiniciaceeketege niɡ̶ina libatadi ‘uuva’. Odaa Eiodi baɡ̶a liciagi nawodaɡ̶anaɡ̶a jeɡ̶epaa doweditedeloco elanigije ‘uuva’.
Nakagidi inoatawece libiwedi ane deɡ̶etayeteda. Ibinie inoatawece libiwedi anepaɡ̶a etaye, eotedibige mepaanaɡ̶a dáwe.
Niɡ̶ida makaamitiwaji ja ɡ̶adapiti leeɡ̶odi me iwaɡ̶ati niɡ̶inoa yotaɡ̶a anejitedaɡ̶awa.

Ele midioka limeditiwaji me ɡ̶adexocitigi, odaa Ee idiokaanaɡ̶a limedi me idexogotaɡ̶agitiwaji. Naɡ̶ana libiwe idoka etaye nigalee yexogotege naɡ̶ada libatadi ‘uuva’. Jiɡ̶idaaɡ̶enitiwaji, idoka akati me áwe nige ɡ̶adexocitigi.

Ee libatadi ‘uuva’. Odaa akaamitiwaji libiwedi. Niɡ̶ina anidioka limedi me yexogotigi, Ee aaɡ̶aɡ̶a idexogotege, codaa joaniɡ̶iniaa ane dáwe. Igaataɡ̶a nige daɡ̶a ɡ̶adexocitigitiwaji, odaa aɡ̶ica anakati mawii.
Niɡ̶ina ane daɡ̶a yexogotigi, joaniɡ̶iniaa oyaladiticogi we, yadilo micoataɡ̶a niɡ̶inoa niale libiwedi anoiladie, odaa joɡ̶oyokoletiogi noledi moyalegi.
Nigidioka limedi me ɡ̶adexocitigitiwaji, codaa nigidioka limedi mowoo yotaɡ̶a, anipokitiwa niɡ̶ica anemaani, odaa jaotaɡ̶adomitiwaji.
Odoɡ̶etetalo Eiodi, niɡ̶ina nige áwetiwaji. Odaa jaɡ̶akaami niɡ̶ina anoniotici.
Ja ɡ̶ademaanitiwaji digo anigotediwa Eiodi me idemaa. Idoka enitatiwaji midioka limedi me ɡ̶adexocitigi amaleeɡ̶aɡ̶a jikee me ɡ̶ademaanitiwaji.
Niɡ̶ina nigoteteni iiɡ̶enatakaneɡ̶eco, odaa idioka limedi me jikee me ɡ̶ademaanitiwaji, digo aneji me jotete liiɡ̶enatakaneɡ̶eco Eiodi, odaa idioka limedi me idemaa.
Jeɡ̶ejitedaɡ̶awatiwaji niɡ̶inoa yotaɡ̶a amaleeɡ̶aɡ̶a itiwaɡ̶aji inikegi, odaa eliodi ɡ̶adinikegitiwaji.
Joaniɡ̶idaa iiɡ̶enatakaneɡ̶egi, madinemaanitiwagetiwaji, digo anejigotaɡ̶awa me ɡ̶ademaani.
Aɡ̶ica ane daɡ̶axa me yemaa lokaaɡ̶etedipi, daɡ̶a liciagi niɡ̶ina ane yeleotema lokaaɡ̶etedipi.
Akaami yokaaɡ̶etedipi nigawii niɡ̶ina ane jiiɡ̶etaɡ̶awa.

Aɡ̶ejitaɡ̶awa makaami iotagipi, igaataɡ̶a niɡ̶ina niotagi ayowooɡ̶odi niɡ̶ica aneo niɡ̶ini niotagodi. Pida ejitaɡ̶awatiwaji makaami yokaaɡ̶etedipi leeɡ̶odi jeɡ̶ejitedaɡ̶awatiwaji ijoatawece aneetediwa Eiodi.

Anaɡ̶akamaɡ̶a adiolaaticetiwaji, pida Ee ɡ̶adiolaatice, odaa ja ɡ̶adiomaɡ̶atiticoace jaotibige memii, codaa me áwe, odaa niɡ̶inoa ɡ̶atá abeyagi. Joaniɡ̶idaaɡ̶ee, Eiodi yajigotedaɡ̶awatiwaji inoatawece ane ipokitibige, niɡ̶ina me abakeni Iboonaɡ̶adi.
Joaniɡ̶idaa me ɡ̶adiiɡ̶enitiwaji madinemaanitiwage.
Oko anida aneetege niɡ̶ina iiɡ̶o neleɡ̶etedi niɡ̶ina anodiotibece Jesus
Nigakaami neleɡ̶etedipi niɡ̶ina oko anida aneetege niɡ̶ina iiɡ̶o, analakitibigetiwaji me Ee odoejegi me Ee neleɡ̶edi.

Igaataɡ̶a diɡ̶ida anenitegetiwaji niɡ̶ina iiɡ̶o, daɡ̶anagawini niɡ̶ina oko etiɡ̶ademaani, igaataɡ̶a inoka oyemaa niɡ̶ina ane nebi, anida aneetege niɡ̶ina iiɡ̶o. Pida ja ɡ̶adiomaɡ̶atiticoace liwigotigi niɡ̶ina oko, ɡ̶adixipeniticoace, odaa aɡ̶aleeɡ̶ica anenitege. Joaniɡ̶idaa leeɡ̶odi makaami neleɡ̶etedipi.

Analakitibige niɡ̶ijo mejitaɡ̶awatiwaji, niɡ̶ina nimeedi anaɡ̶axateloco niotagodi. Odaa niɡ̶ina oko anida aneetege niɡ̶ina iiɡ̶o nigetidiatetibeci, odaa akaami aaɡ̶aɡ̶a etiɡ̶adiatenitibece. Doɡ̶oyotete yotaɡ̶a, odaa taɡ̶aɡ̶a oyotete ɡ̶adotaɡ̶atiwaji.
Pida leeɡ̶odi mida anenitigi jiɡ̶idaa midoɡ̶odigotaɡ̶awatiwaji, igaataɡ̶a aɡ̶oyowooɡ̶odi Niɡ̶ijoa ane idimonya.
Niɡ̶ina daaditaɡ̶a janagi, jeloɡ̶oditiogi, agotiɡ̶ica libeyaceɡ̶egi ane yeloɡ̶o. Pida niɡ̶ina natigide aɡ̶aleeɡ̶ica oko ane yakadi me yaɡ̶aditini libeyaceɡ̶egi.
Niɡ̶ina ane Ee leleɡ̶edi, aaɡ̶aɡ̶a leleɡ̶edi Eiodi.

Niɡ̶ina daaditiɡ̶icoateda ɡ̶odoxiceɡ̶etedi ane jaote lodoe, ane diɡ̶ica ane yakadi meo liciagi, odaa niɡ̶inoa loenataka ane beyagi agotaɡ̶a yeloɡ̶o. Pida noɡ̶onadi ɡ̶odoxiceɡ̶etedi ane jaote, odaa joɡ̶oyelatomi, codaa Eiodi moyelatema.
Pida mina jiɡ̶idaaɡ̶ee, icota niɡ̶ijo ane diniditeloco notaɡ̶anaɡ̶axi midiwataɡ̶a niiɡ̶enatakaneɡ̶eco, niɡ̶ijo anee, ‘Aɡ̶ica ane leeɡ̶odi moyelatomi’.

Niɡ̶ijo Ǥanaxawanatitoɡ̶odi, Aneotedoɡ̶oji Liwigo, icota meno, odaa beɡ̶ewi me ikeetaɡ̶awa anodaaɡ̶eji niɡ̶ina moyalaɡ̶atiwa, icoɡ̶otibigimece miniwataɡ̶a Eiodi. Jinimonyataɡ̶awatiwaji, icoɡ̶otibigimece Eiodi. Odaa nigeno, jeɡ̶eetece anodaaɡ̶eji.
Odaa akaamitiwaji jaɡ̶aɡ̶a enitece anodaaɡ̶eji, leeɡ̶odi makaamitiwaji meetaɡ̶a, niɡ̶ijo maleekoka ɡ̶adiomaɡ̶atiticoace, codaa niɡ̶ina natigide.
